formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Code Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C3.1 + C3.2.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can write code with a loop and predict what it does.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write code with a loop and predict what it does.
header.character_watermark: Coda in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Write a loop to make Coda do 5 forward steps.
prompts.visual_layout: Top half. A blank code line.

image_placeholders.description: A blank code-writing line in B&W, ~7in × 0.7in. Format: 'Repeat ___: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_LOOP: keywords (loop, code) name what the line asks for.

prompts.prompt: Read this code and predict where Coda ends. Code: 'Repeat 3: right'. Coda starts at (0,0).
prompts.visual_layout: Middle. A blank grid for marking.

image_placeholders.description: A 5x5 grid in B&W on a portrait letter page. Coda's starting position (0,0) marked with a small dot.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_PREDICT_GRID: keywords (grid, predict) name what the grid asks for.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three faces in a row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row. Smile, neutral, frown.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: loop correct + position correct = ready for Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Coding Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Coda with a Junior Coder certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Coder? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE coding task?

image_placeholders.description: Four icons in B&W: sequential code, loop code, prediction, alter code. Each ~1in × 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the four options.

prompts.visual_layout: Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5.
